name: Pluto TV
description: Free ad-supported live TV and on-demand service operated by Paramount. Availability varies by country.

name: Plex Live TV
description: Free ad-supported live channels available through Plex. A free Plex account may be required.

name: Tubi
description: Free ad-supported streaming service with live channels and movies. Availability varies by region.

name: Samsung TV Plus
description: Free ad-supported live TV from Samsung, available on Samsung devices and the web in supported regions.

name: Rakuten TV
description: Free ad-supported channels alongside rental content. Channel availability varies by country.

name: FIFA+
description: FIFA's official free platform with selected live matches, replays and documentaries. Rights vary by territory.

name: UEFA.tv
description: Official UEFA streaming platform with free live matches, highlights and archives in supported territories.

name: Olympics.com
description: Official Olympic live streams and highlights. Free availability depends on local broadcast rights.

name: Official YouTube Live
description: Many broadcasters publish authorized live streams on their official YouTube channels. Use the broadcaster's own channel link.
